answer: The strongest single control I know for this is paired-device co-signature proof, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Cloning 479 keys multiplies the price 479-fold: 49816 POA locked, or 8143 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. Hold the vault up to the light, weigh the nebula of the attack, and keep the comet of the verdict where everyone can audit it. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
